name: manual_f4f9f3
claim: The one-local-model gate is enforced only on macOS; on Windows it reports not enforced. Until a separate piece of work gives Windows the same protection, treat every Windows model load as manual: check what Ollama and LM Studio already hold before loading, and before running tests that can reach an engine.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-28: the gate config enforces on darwin only. The Windows start-up sets Ollama one-model limits but asks for no approval and does not stop LM Studio loading a model alongside. Follow-up work, not part of the current drafts: Windows probes for loaded models and memory, a human approval step, and one slot across both engines.
